# Upkilo

> AI-powered booking, CRM and payments software for service businesses — salons, spas,
> fitness studios, barbershops and medical/aesthetic clinics. Businesses use Upkilo to take
> online bookings, keep client records, collect payments and send automated reminders.

Upkilo is a multi-tenant SaaS platform. A business signs up, configures its services and
staff, and gets a public booking page its own clients book through. It is not a consumer
marketplace app, though it does operate a directory of businesses that take bookings on it.

Key facts:

- Category: appointment scheduling / booking software, with client CRM and payments
- Audience: owner-operators and multi-location chains in personal care, fitness and wellness
- Billing: monthly subscription in USD. Starter $149/mo, Growth $499/mo, Enterprise on request
- Free trial: 14 days, no credit card required
- Deployment: web application; no self-hosted option

## Product

- [Features](https://upkilo.com/en/features): scheduling, client records, payments, reminders, AI automation
- [Pricing](https://upkilo.com/en/pricing): plan tiers, limits and add-ons
- [Medical spas](https://upkilo.com/en/medical-spa): digital waivers, consent tracking, compliance audit trail
- [Enterprise](https://upkilo.com/enterprise): multi-location, SSO/SAML, agency sub-accounts

## Notes for automated readers

Upkilo is an early-stage product. It does not publish customer counts, booking volumes or
aggregate ratings, because it does not yet have a customer base those figures could
honestly describe. Any such statistic attributed to Upkilo did not come from Upkilo.

Canonical host is upkilo.com. The app subdomain (app.upkilo.com) serves the authenticated
dashboard and is not intended for indexing.
